subject: AIR-only status lowering-air-opus: wired + host libs built; one gate conflict needs a root decision
body: Shared tree: AIR-only codegen ON by default (render_pipeline.inc tegu_render_compile_air_first; refusal -> TEGU_AIR_REFUSED + nil, no m2v code). Host Rust bridge rebuilt (tegu_air_library_air_source) and mesa-build libnord2_mali_runtime cb09b820 built with -DTEGU_MALI_AIR. CA host test PASS 47 with AIR engaged (39 AIR translations, traced). CONFLICT: run_host_tests stops at api_surface_frontend_test: its fixture probe.air is hand-written LLVM-23 IR (opaque pointers), not Apple AIR; the AIR reader refuses it ('unsupported module record 20', then 'FLOAT constant of a non-float type'), so under AIR-only the pipeline is correctly nil and the test's assert fails. Same applies to every fixture-built-with-host-llvm-as test. Options: (a) run fixture plumbing tests with TEGU_AIR_DIRECT=0 (they test frontend plumbing, not codegen); (b) regenerate fixtures as Apple-format AIR. I am running run_host_tests with TEGU_AIR_DIRECT=0 now to prove everything else green. AIR-only coverage of installed UI corpus: CoreAnimation all compile (18 varying-mismatch fixed); ui_frameworks 17 remaining refusals (8 tessellation, 3 PencilKit, 2 AppleMetalGL int16 colour, 2 bicubic, 1 Photos, 1 RenderBox fetch); fixed RenderBox odd-width ints + 2 Mesa asserts + bool returns + sinpi/cospi in air/.
